activity.notes: Babur founded the Mughal Empire in northern India after the 1526 conquest and ruled it until his death in 1530. Earlier Timurid/Fergana and Kabul phases are not collapsed into this Mughal Activity.

sources.title: BĀBOR, ẒAHĪR-AL-DĪN MOḤAMMAD — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Describes Babur as the Timurid prince who founded the Mughal Empire in India and died in 1530.

sources.title: Babur — historical summary
sources.citation_text: Dates the founding Mughal imperial phase from 1526 until Babur's death in 1530.
